title: Recovery Manual
summary: Recover graves with a plan, a compass, spare gear, and the humility to make the second run safer.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Recovery systems reduce the cost of death without removing the need for planning. A recovery route is still an expedition, not a sprint back into the same hazard.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Keep a spare kit at base: food, blocks, weapon, light, and a recovery compass if available. Do not retrieve valuables while naked and unprepared.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Identify the grave, choose the safest route, carry a minimal recovery kit, retrieve inventory, and leave before converting recovery into another loss.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Grave snapshots, compass target data, dimension behavior, expiration rules, and contamination notes can all change the best retrieval plan.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: WorldCore explains hazard context, HoloMap marks the path, WeatherCore can delay unsafe returns, and Logistics can stage spare kits.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If the compass seems unclear, check dimension, target status, expiration, and whether multiple graves share similar ids. Travel slower on the recovery run than on the failed one.
